Complete [[Dzagonur Bastion]].

==Quest information==
===Objectives===
*Defend [[Dzagonur Bastion (outpost)|Dzagonur Bastion]] against the invading generals.
* *BONUS* Keep the defensive structures intact.
* *BONUS* Complete the mission in [[Hard Mode]].
* See [[Zehnchu]] <nowiki>[</nowiki>[[Zaishen]] Challenge] for your reward.

===Reward===
* 5,000 [[Experience]]
* 1,000 [[Gold]]
* 500 [[Sunspear Promotion Point]]s
* Complete the Base Objective for 30 [[Copper Zaishen Coin|Zaishen Copper Coins]].
* Complete the first *BONUS* Objective for an additional 45 Zaishen Copper Coins.
* Complete the second *BONUS* Objective for an additional 75 Zaishen Copper Coins.

==Walkthrough==
As per the [[Dzagonur Bastion]] mission.

:''"[[Prince Ahmtur the Mighty]] needs your help in resisting the invading forces at Dzagonur Bastion. Contact the [[Master of Whispers]] and join the forces at the citadel."''
